name: Mutsuboshi Kirari
source:
An ancient town in the alternative modern Japan. 
Main character is a sophomore student dating a girl. Both of them join the famous astronomy department. Protagonist is fascinated with the mysterious female head of the club who organizes night star-gazing trips frequently. He decides to date both girls, because it's youth time when everything's possible.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在架空现代日本的一座古镇。
身为二年级学生的主人公与女友一同加入了校内赫赫有名的天文社，却深深迷上了经常组织夜间观星活动的神秘女社长。仗着正值“一切皆有可能”的青春年华，他索性决定脚踏两条船，同时与两名少女交往。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
